### Added

- *(gs,kubernetes-react)* Show version, provider and location for CAPZ managed (AKS) clusters in [#2677](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2677) by [@luca-rui](https://github.com/luca-rui)
- *(agent-platform)* Explain failed agents and tighten the agent detail page in [#2709](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2709) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(gs)* Option to exclude management clusters from the cluster picker in [#2708](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2708) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(platform-capabilities)* Render the ready to merge action state in [#2713](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2713) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(analytics)* Track meaningful portal actions in TelemetryDeck in [#2712](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2712) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.85.0...v2.86.0-rc.5
